messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Namaste, main Delhi Customs se Officer Rakesh Verma bol raha hu.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Haan boliye?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aapke Aadhaar se ek parcel Cambodia bheja gaya hai jisme 6 fake passport aur drugs mile hai. FIR darj ho chuki hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Maine koi parcel nahi bheja!

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Ab CBI officer aapse video call pe baat karenge. Call cut mat karna aur ghar me kisi ko mat batana, warna turant arrest hoga.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Ok sir, main dar gaya hu

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Innocent prove karne ke liye apne saving account ka saara paisa RBI verification account me transfer karo. Jaanch ke baad 24 ghante me wapas.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: This is Inspector Sameer Khan, Mumbai Cyber Police. A money laundering case has been registered against your mobile number.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: What? Which case?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Your number was used to open a bank account used in a ₹2.3 crore fraud. This is a non-bailable offence.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: You are under digital arrest. Stay on this WhatsApp video call and do not contact your family or lawyer.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Please help me, what should I do?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Pay ₹1,85,000 as a refundable security deposit to the account below to stop the arrest warrant. A/c 50200098765432

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Dear customer, your SBI YONO account will be suspended today due to incomplete KYC.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Is this from SBI?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Yes. Please update immediately to avoid blocking: sbi-yono-kyc-update.in

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: The site is asking for my card details

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Correct, fill all details. You will get an OTP, share it here to complete verification.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: नमस्ते, मैं आपके बैंक के KYC विभाग से बोल रहा हूँ।

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: जी बोलिए

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: आपका PAN कार्ड खाते से लिंक नहीं है, आज रात आपका खाता बंद हो जाएगा।

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: अब क्या करना होगा?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: आपके फ़ोन पर एक OTP आया होगा, वह तुरंत बताइए, मैं अभी KYC पूरा कर देता हूँ।

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Hi, this is Anil sir. This is my new number, please save it.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Hello sir, saved.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I'm in a board meeting and can't take calls. I need you to handle something urgent and keep it confidential.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Sure sir, what is it?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Buy 4 Amazon gift cards of ₹10,000 each for a client and send me the codes here. I'll reimburse you by evening.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Priya, main Mehta sir. Abhi call nahi le sakta, client ke saath hu.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Ek vendor ko urgent ₹3,40,000 transfer karna hai aaj hi. Accounts team ko abhi mat batana, deal confidential hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Sir approval mail bhej dijiye

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Mail baad me karunga, pehle payment karo aur UTR screenshot bhejo. Account details neeche.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Welcome to Bull Run VIP group 🚀 Hamare members ne is hafte 18% profit kamaya 💰

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Kaise join karte hai?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Guaranteed 5-10% weekly return. Seats aaj raat band ho jayengi ⏰

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Mujhe interest hai

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Institutional account kholne ke liye ye app download karo aur ₹50,000 deposit karo 👉 bullrun-inst.app/download

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: नमस्कार, मी शेअर मार्केट VIP ग्रुपमधून बोलतोय. आमच्या सदस्यांना दरमहा 30% नफा मिळतो.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: खरंच?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: ही संधी फक्त आज आहे, उद्या जागा संपतील.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: मला काय करावे लागेल?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: तुमचा नफा काढण्यासाठी आधी ₹25,000 टॅक्स भरा, मग सगळे पैसे खात्यात येतील.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Hello 😊 I'm Neha from DigitalBoost HR. We offer part-time work from home, earn up to ₹3,000 daily by liking videos.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: What do I need to do?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Your first 3 tasks are paid ✅ ₹150 credited. Join our Telegram group for VIP tasks.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Ok joined

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Next is a prepaid task: deposit ₹2,000 and get ₹2,700 back in 30 minutes. Limited slots, do it fast!

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: घर बैठे पार्ट टाइम नौकरी, रोज़ ₹2,500 तक कमाएँ।

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: काम क्या है?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: बस वीडियो लाइक करने हैं। पहले रजिस्ट्रेशन के लिए ₹999 फीस भरनी होगी, पहली सैलरी के साथ वापस मिलेगी।

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: ठीक है

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: आज ही भरें वरना आपकी सीट किसी और को दे दी जाएगी।

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Instant loan ₹2,00,000 tak 10 minute me ⚡ No CIBIL check

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Mujhe 50k chahiye

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aapka loan approve ho gaya hai 🎉 bas ₹1,999 processing fee aaj bharni hogi

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Fee loan se kaat lo

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Nahi sir, company rule hai. Fee nahi bhari toh approval cancel ho jayega aur CIBIL kharab hoga

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Your loan of ₹5,000 was due yesterday. Total payable with penalty is now ₹11,800.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: I took only 5000

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: We have your contact list and photos from the app. Pay today or every contact gets a message that you are a fraud.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Pay only to this UPI: recovery.desk77@ybl. Do not call customer care.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Hi didi! Kaisi ho? Bahut time ho gaya 😊

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Arre Ritu! Main theek, tum batao?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sab badhiya. Main ghar se ek part time kaam kar rahi hu, roz ₹2,000 aa jaate hai 😍

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Kaisa kaam?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bas YouTube videos like karne hai. Main tumhe group me add karwa deti hu, pehla task free hai

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: VIP task ke liye ₹3,000 deposit karna hota hai, 1 ghante me ₹4,200 wapas milta hai. Aaj hi karna, slots kam hai

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Good morning! Saw your post about learning stock trading 📈

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Yes, I'm a beginner

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Great! I share free tips with a few friends, no charges. Today's tip: watch banking stocks.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Thanks!

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Our mentor's VIP group gives guaranteed 8% weekly. Only 20 seats left this week, join before tonight.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Deposit ₹30,000 in the institutional app to start. I'll help you set it up.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Beta khana kha liya?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Haan mummy

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Kal ki fees ₹18,500 tere account me bhej di hai, receipt bhej dena 🙏

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Thank you mummy

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aur koi bhi OTP maange toh mat batana, bank kabhi nahi maangta

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Dear customer, ₹2,500 debited from A/c XX1234 on 21-Oct via UPI. Not you? Call 1800-1234 (toll free).

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Yes that was me

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Your OTP for login is 482913. Do not share it with anyone. SBI never asks for OTP.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: सर्व सभासदांना सूचना: तिसऱ्या तिमाहीचे देखभाल शुल्क ₹4,200 10 तारखेपर्यंत भरावे.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: ठीक आहे

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: उद्या सकाळी 10 ते 2 पाणी बंद राहील, पाणी भरून ठेवा 🙏

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Team, please release the vendor payment for Zenith after the approval in ERP. Approval note AP/2026/1187.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Done, sharing UTR on email

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Thanks! Also the audit meeting moved to Friday 3 PM.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bhai ek forward aaya hai 'digital arrest' wala, kisi CBI officer ka video call. Ye scam hai, kabhi paise mat bhejna!

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Haan maine bhi news me padha

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Cybercrime pe 1930 call karna hota hai aise case me

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: बेटा, नया पेंशन फॉर्म बैंक में जमा कर दिया है।

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: ठीक है पापा

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: मैनेजर ने कहा अगले महीने से पेंशन सीधे खाते में आएगी।
